uncited: - **Coordinate System Mismatch**: COLMAP uses a right-handed coordinate system with Z-forward, while many renderers use Y-up or Z-up.
- **Intrinsic Model Variance**: Different camera models (PINHOLE, SIMPLE_RADIAL, etc.) have different parameter counts.
- **Memory Limits**: Large point clouds can exceed GPU memory.
- **Memory Complexity**: Proportional to the number of points and images loaded.
